2121781479910883578.en_summary: Energy stocks are making history: The S&P 500 Energy sector took just 196 trading days to gain +50% year-to-date, the 5th-fastest any S&P 500 sector has reached this milestone since 1990. In 2022 it surged +50% in 94 trading days, the fastest in 36 years. Technology took 133 and 160 trading days in 1996 and 1997. Consumer Discretionary, Consumer Staples, Industrials, Materials, and Real Estate have never recorded a +50% annual gain since 1990. The Energy sector is witnessing one of its most remarkable rallies in decades.
2121781479910883578.zh_summary: 能源股票正在創造歷史：標普500能源板塊僅用196個交易日就實現年初至今+50%漲幅，是1990年以來任何標普500板塊達到這一里程碑的第5快速度。2022年它在94個交易日內飆升+50%，是36年來最快。科技板塊在1996年和1997年分別用了133和160個交易日。消費可選、消費必需、工業、材料及房地產自1990年以來從未錄得+50%的年度漲幅。能源板塊正在見證數十年來最引人注目的漲勢之一。

2121778596507533816.en_summary: If AI is really so critical that being just a few years behind is a matter of life and death, then China could blow the whole thing up right now. For example, China could restrict rare-earth exports, take over Taiwan to prevent the U.S. from getting advanced chips, and disrupt the supply of many other critical components. My point is, I don’t think China sees AI that way. I think they’re willing to fall a few years behind while their domestic chip manufacturing catches up. Importing downgraded NVIDIA chips wouldn’t do much to help them achieve their long-term goals. And I don’t think China is thinking small, either. They probably want to dominate the global AI market in the future, not just their domestic market. That’s why I think they’re playing the long game. (Quoted: If AI, especially GPUs, is like nuclear weapons, then China should just take over Taiwan now... Either Xi or Dario is dead wrong here.)
2121778596507533816.zh_summary: 如果AI真的如此關鍵，落後幾年就是生死侑關，那麼中國現在就可以把整個事情搞砸。例如，中國可以限制稀土出口、接管台灣以防止美國獲得先進芯片，並擾亂許多其他關鍵部件的供應。我的觀點是，我不認為中國以那種方式看待AI。我認為他們願意落後幾年，同時讓國內芯片製造趕上。進口降級的NVIDIA芯片對實現其長期目標幫助不大。我也不認為中國想得小。他們可能想在未來主導全球AI市場，而不只是國內市場。這就是為什麼我認為他們在玩長期遊戲。(引用：如果AI尤其是GPU像核武器，那麼中國現在就應該接管台灣……要麼習要麼Dario大錯特錯。)
